facts.fact: A draft of the Data Protection (Data Processors Engagement) Regulations, 2025, dated 6 October 2025 and marked subject to change, would require a processor's agreement to bar transfer of personal data from Malawi to another country except on the controller's written instructions and in compliance with Part VII of the Data Protection Act.

systems.owner: Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (author); Minister of Information and Digitalization (maker)

note: Draft regulation; its standard contractual clauses govern controller-processor engagement, not a published means of complying with the transfer rule, so no use fact.
